title: Peace for the road ahead
text: Be still, and know that I am God. As you walk, breathe slowly. Christ walks with you. You do not have to hurry your heart. (Psalm 46:10)

title: Held, not hurried
text: Come to me, all who are weary, and I will give you rest. Let each step remind you: you are carried by grace, not by your own strength. (Matthew 11:28)

title: The Lord is my shepherd
text: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want. He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters. He restores my soul. (Psalm 23:1-3)

title: Cast your cares
text: Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you. Name one worry with each breath, and leave it with Jesus as you walk on. (1 Peter 5:7)

title: Peace I leave with you
text: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give to you. Not as the world gives do I give to you. Let not your hearts be troubled, neither let them be afraid. (John 14:27)

title: Gentle and lowly
text: Jesus is gentle and lowly in heart. He does not crush the bruised reed. Bring him your tiredness exactly as it is; he receives you with kindness. (Matthew 12:20)

title: Be still
text: Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth! (Psalm 46:10)

title: He restores my soul
text: When your soul feels thin, remember the Shepherd restores. Rest is not laziness; it is trust. Walk slowly and let him refill you. (Psalm 23:3)

title: Do not fear
text: Fear not, for I am with you; be not dismayed, for I am your God; I will strengthen you, I will help you, I will uphold you with my righteous right hand. (Isaiah 41:10)

title: Quiet waters
text: He leads me beside still waters. If your day is loud, let this moment be quiet water. Listen more than you speak, and rest in his presence. (Psalm 23:2)
